difficulty_reason: Prove Cohstack^P_{X/B} is algebraic with a flat closed immersion into Cohstack_{X/B}, and open-and-closed when I is finite or B is locally Noetherian: for finite I the functions chi_i are locally constant so the condition is open and closed; for infinite I express Cohstack^P as the intersection of the finite-subset pieces P|_{I'} - always a flat closed immersion, possibly not open (the author leaves examples to the reader, a non-load-bearing aside); if B is locally Noetherian then so is Cohstack_{X/B}, and on a smooth surjective locally Noetherian cover U the inverse images of the open-and-closed finite pieces have open intersection because connected components of locally Noetherian spaces are open.
